findings.problem: Ritual affordability says to 'reuse the same RITUAL_LIST filtering predicate AdvancementPage uses' but does not restate the lore-match branch. The real predicate (AdvancementPage.tsx ~1120-1123) excludes a ritual unless r.lore is 'Any'/'Any Lore' or matches getCharacterLore(character), and keys the already-learned exclusion on ritual name. An implementer could ship a name+XP-only filter and surface rituals of a lore the character cannot learn.
findings.fix: State explicitly: candidate iff !learnedNames.has(r.name) AND (r.lore === 'Any' || r.lore === 'Any Lore' || r.lore === getCharacterLore(character)), then affordable iff xpCur >= r.learningXP — mirroring the RITUAL_LIST.filter branch verbatim.

findings.problem: The per-type characteristic bonus is described in prose and anchored to handleLearnSpell, which computes only intBonus. The Assistant iterates all getSpellcastingTypes in one pass, so it must compute both WPB and IntB and select per type; copying handleLearnSpell's single-bonus shape would pass IntB for petty too.
findings.fix: Pin it: compute WPB = getBonus(WP...) and IntB = getBonus(Int...) up front, then per type `const bonus = type === 'petty' ? WPB : IntB; const cost = getSpellLearningCost(type, countMemorizedByType(character)[type], bonus);` (miracle/chaos ignore bonus).
